entries.18b530fce62838fd: A company that provides equipment such as railways, power facilities, elevators and home appliances, as well as IT systems and digital services.
entries.1a822d766e724eb2: Digital Solutions (System Integration, Cloud Services, Consulting Services)
entries.1f4cf900b12bf33b: Real Estate Management, Sales and Leasing
entries.24c4ab62834285e2: This segment handles railway systems. It is handled by an internal railway business unit and the consolidated subsidiary Hitachi Rail. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026, including internal revenue between segments, was ¥1,321,571 million.
entries.2f6971a4dcd35216: This segment handles digital solutions such as system integration, cloud services and consulting, as well as IT products such as storage and servers, software and ATMs. Hitachi Solutions, Hitachi Systems, Hitachi Vantara, Hitachi Channel Solutions, GlobalLogic Worldwide Holdings and Hitachi Digital are the main consolidated subsidiaries. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026, including internal revenue between segments, was ¥2,940,057 million.
entries.6002c16749c69363: This segment handles building elevators and escalators, home appliances and air conditioning, industrial equipment, measurement and analysis systems such as semiconductor manufacturing equipment and medical analysis equipment, solutions for industry and distribution, and water and environmental solutions. Hitachi Building Systems, Hitachi Global Life Solutions, Hitachi High-Tech, Hitachi Industrial Equipment Systems, Hitachi Industrial Products, Hitachi Elevator (China) and others are the main consolidated subsidiaries. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026, including internal revenue between segments, was ¥3,262,791 million, the largest of the 5 segments.
entries.a4b37b5171e70242: Living and Ecosystem (Home Appliances, Air Conditioning)
entries.b281f2f5f5b52106: This segment handles energy-related products and solutions, centered on power grids and nuclear power. Hitachi Energy, which took over the power grid business from Switzerland's ABB in 2021, Hitachi GE Vernova Nuclear Energy and Hitachi Plant Construction are the main consolidated subsidiaries. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026, including internal revenue between segments, was ¥3,219,953 million, the 2nd largest of the 5 segments.
entries.c3b4819eef2a651b: Measurement and Analysis Systems (Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment, Medical Analysis Equipment)
entries.fc143f24d093590c: This segment handles real estate management, sales and leasing. In addition to Hitachi Real Estate Partners, Hitachi America, Hitachi Asia, Hitachi (China), Hitachi Europe and Hitachi India, which are regional headquarters companies for the Americas, Asia, China, Europe and India, are included in this segment and sell Group products. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026, including internal revenue between segments, was ¥531,089 million.
